overview_description.description: PiP World operates in Web3, gaming, and EdTech, focusing on financial literacy through game-based learning. Its ecosystem includes the Roblox stock simulator StockRise, the Telegram game Gold Rush, the planned mobile game PiP Trader, and PiP Academy for financial education. The platform targets users interested in learning investing and trading concepts, particularly in emerging markets across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. PiP World has raised $10 million in seed funding from Exinity.
